image_rules: marketplace OSDiskImage exposes operatingSystem only; no fabricated sizeInGB/architecture there
minimum_os_disk_gib plus minimum_os_disk_source are explicit central administrator attestation, not inferred from absent API data
reject unknown/minimum missing or mutable latest image references

child_public_ip.rule: current qualified provider omits SKU; do not claim Standard is dispatched. Gate requested public IP until actual child SKU/default is independently qualified.

price_rules: missing disk rate is unknown, never zero
actual effective dates/observed timestamps remain attached to each charged component
changing quote duration does not create a new minimum commitment
meter IDs are billing identity, not HTTP provider request IDs
transaction-dependent disk cost needs an explicit estimate/bound or an honest exclusion; no implicit zero guarantee
read_only_observations: CloudCatalog inspect/list are independent ARM observations, not mutation/lifecycle duplication. Unknown lookup must fail List conservatively, never become successful empty inventory.
hardware_rules: SKU CpuArchitectureType must match image/profile architecture; unknown cannot prove a match
ResourceSku.family is the family identifier; do not collapse Standard_* names to family Standard
constrained-vCPU availability uses vCPUsAvailable before full physical vCPUs
byte/MB throughput and GPU/temporary-disk memory parsing retain Decimal fractions
whole GPU/resource disks supplied by exact VM flavor require metadata, not nonexistent provisioning extras
missing vendor/model/VRAM may be resolved by explicit central per-SKU accelerator facts with source provenance; count must still agree with actual SKU data
quote_tamper_cases: spot bool disagrees with candidate market
native region/image version or minimum provenance no longer matches binding

accelerator_fact_example.count: actual SKU GPUs=1 (synthetic API fixture); do not infer from SKU name
accelerator_fact_example.scope: central operator attestation, not runtime guest/driver qualification

explicit_size_case.reason: child127 default only applies when disk_size_gb is omitted

rules: properties.plan is real image metadata; qualified child does not map VM Plan, so any non-null plan is unsupported
non-Windows does not establish zero image-software charges
central licensing facts must explicitly attest no extra software charges or Windows license included in selected compute meter, with source provenance
unknown or additional unpriced software licensing excludes/fails explicitly
quote re-reads image plan and current exact central licensing binding

cases.name: windows_included
cases.central_licensing: source-attested included in Windows compute meter
